tagline: A global investor and operator of high-quality infrastructure assets
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the primary driver of structural growth, capturing sustained demand for data centers, fiber networks and telecommunications towers linked to the cloud and AI explosion.

kpis.name: Digital Infrastructure Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by data centers, fiber networks and telecommunications towers.
kpis.description: The Digital Infrastructure segment is the most dynamic in the portfolio, benefiting from recurring contracts and strong demand.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth driven by cloud and AI.

kpis.name: Funds From Operations
kpis.explanation: Key measure of financial performance for real estate and infrastructure companies.
kpis.description: FFO is a central indicator for assessing BIP's cash generation capacity.
kpis.signal: FFO growth, reflecting the strength of operating cash flows.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital spending to maintain or extend assets.
kpis.description: Sustained capex reflects commitment to new digital infrastructure projects.
kpis.signal: Strong capex growth, signaling strategic expansion.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin reflects asset quality and revenue visibility.
kpis.signal: High gross margin, typical of contractual infrastructure assets.

kpis.name: Net Debt to EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Measures leverage relative to cash flow generation capacity.
kpis.description: The ratio remains manageable thanks to EBITDA stability and prudent debt management.
kpis.signal: Slight deterioration in ratio, but still within target range.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of direct and indirect employees.
kpis.description: Headcount is increasing slowly, primarily in digital and energy operations.
kpis.signal: Moderate headcount growth, aligned with asset expansion.

kpis.name: Data Center Capacity (MW)
kpis.explanation: Installed power across the portfolio's data centers.
kpis.description: Data center capacity is growing strongly, particularly in North America and Asia.
kpis.signal: Rapid capacity expansion, responding to cloud and AI demand.

kpis.name: Fiber Passings
kpis.explanation: Number of homes or buildings accessible to the fiber optic network.
kpis.description: Fiber deployment continues to accelerate, driven by bandwidth demand.
kpis.signal: Growing fiber penetration, driver of recurring revenue.

ai_positioning.summary: BIP does not develop AI in-house but invests heavily in the physical infrastructure supporting AI (data centers, networks).
evidence: 18% growth in data center capacity in 2025
Capex targeted at AI hubs in Asia and North America
